newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Escorts Finance 1996/97 1st half net up.
newsitem.headline: India's Escorts Finance 1996/97 1st half net up.

text.p: India's Escorts Finance Limited posted a net profit of 78.7 million rupees ($2.2 million) in the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) against 65.2 million rupees in the same period last year, the company said on Monday.
The company said in a statement that its income from operations increased 87.8 percent to 478.7 million rupees from 254.8 million rupees in the previous period.

"Escorts Income Bond, the first mutual fund launched by Escorts Finance Limited during the six months period under review, garnered 208.5 million rupees despite tough market conditions," Jayant Dang, company's managing director said.
